market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. 10-year yield at 5% with strategist warning selloff continues. AI narrative shift creating tech volatility. Oil elevated on geopolitics. Expect 5-10% equity drawdown in tech before stabilization. Dollar strength persists. Credit stress may broaden.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if yields stabilize. AI slowdown call is narrative, not fundamental — cloud capex (AMZN, MSFT, GOOGL) remains robust. Energy transition plays (ENB, TTE) offer structural growth. Private credit will normalize. US-China tech decoupling continues. Watch for Fed policy pivot if inflation reaccelerates.
